newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.

text.p: Rubber futures closed lower across the board in moderate trade on some late local selling interest in line with weaker Japanese prices, brokers said on Wednesday.
They said prices in Tokyo and Kobe were also lower across the board, pressured by sporadic selling, as the market failed to respond to the yen's further slip against the U.S. dollar.

"The market was dead in the morning on a lack of fresh factors. But prices were marked down slightly in the afternoon on some late local selling interest in sympathy with lower prices in Tokyo and Kobe," a local dealer said.
At around 0945 GMT, April RSS3 fell 1.50 cents to 123.00 U.S. cents a kg.
February RSS1 fell 1.50 cents to 170.00 Singapore cents (US$1.21) a kg.
March TSR20 slipped half a cent to 168.25 Singapore cents (US$1.20) a kg.
